## Description

A clear and concise description of the feature or change.

## Motivation

Why is this change needed? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed solution

Describe the solution you'd like. For analytical features (a new
measure, a new read path), say how it fits the specification: gloaming
returns data and hosts render; every measure is exact and
deterministic; the core stays `core:*`-only with no FFI.

## Additional context

Add any other context about the feature request here.
